# Terraform owns this dedicated logs pipeline and its independent durable state.
extensions:
  googleclientauth:
    project: example-project
    quota_project: example-project
  file_storage/cursor:
    directory: /var/lib/superserve/host-logging/cursor
    create_directory: true
    fsync: true
    max_size: 16777216
  file_storage/queue:
    directory: /var/lib/superserve/host-logging/export-queue
    create_directory: true
    fsync: true
    max_size: 2147483648
    # Disable compaction: one bounded database, no temporary second copy.
    compaction:
      on_start: false
      on_rebound: false

receivers:
  journald:
    directory: /var/log/journal
    start_at: beginning
    storage: file_storage/cursor
    retry_on_failure:
      enabled: true
      max_elapsed_time: 0s

processors:
  memory_limiter:
    check_interval: 1s
    limit_mib: 192
    spike_limit_mib: 32
  filter/approved_sources:
    error_mode: propagate
    logs:
      log_record:
        - 'body["_TRANSPORT"] != "kernel" and (body["_SYSTEMD_UNIT"] == nil or not IsMatch(body["_SYSTEMD_UNIT"], "^(superserve-vmd|proxy(-[^.]*)?|systemd(-[^.]*)?|google-(osconfig|guest)-agent|superserve-otel-(collector|logs)|unbound|(superserve-)?secretsproxy|superserve-host-logging-heartbeat)\\.service$")) and not (body["_PID"] == "1" and body["UNIT"] != nil and IsMatch(body["UNIT"], "^(superserve-vmd|proxy(-[^.]*)?)\\.service$"))'
  transform/trusted_payload:
    # Parse failures must never write the input record into collector self-logs.
    error_mode: silent
    log_statements:
      - context: log
        statements:
          - set(cache["journal"], {})
          - set(cache["journal"]["MESSAGE"], body["MESSAGE"]) where IsString(body["MESSAGE"]) and Len(body["MESSAGE"]) <= 65536
          - set(cache["journal"]["_SYSTEMD_UNIT"], body["_SYSTEMD_UNIT"]) where IsString(body["_SYSTEMD_UNIT"]) and Len(body["_SYSTEMD_UNIT"]) <= 256
          - set(cache["journal"]["_TRANSPORT"], body["_TRANSPORT"]) where IsString(body["_TRANSPORT"]) and Len(body["_TRANSPORT"]) <= 256
          - set(cache["journal"]["_PID"], body["_PID"]) where IsString(body["_PID"]) and Len(body["_PID"]) <= 256
          - set(cache["journal"]["_BOOT_ID"], body["_BOOT_ID"]) where IsString(body["_BOOT_ID"]) and Len(body["_BOOT_ID"]) <= 256
          - set(cache["journal"]["UNIT"], body["UNIT"]) where IsString(body["UNIT"]) and Len(body["UNIT"]) <= 256
          - set(cache["journal"]["PRIORITY"], body["PRIORITY"]) where IsString(body["PRIORITY"]) and Len(body["PRIORITY"]) <= 256
          - set(cache["application"], IsMatch(body["_SYSTEMD_UNIT"], "^(superserve-vmd|proxy(-[^.]*)?)\\.service$")) where IsString(body["_SYSTEMD_UNIT"])
          - set(cache["parsed"], ParseJSON(body["MESSAGE"])) where cache["application"] == true and IsString(body["MESSAGE"]) and Len(body["MESSAGE"]) <= 65536
          - set(body, {})
          - keep_keys(attributes, [])
          - keep_keys(resource.attributes, [])
          - set(attributes["journal_unit"], cache["journal"]["_SYSTEMD_UNIT"])
          - set(attributes["unit"], cache["journal"]["UNIT"]) where cache["journal"]["_PID"] == "1"
          - set(attributes["source"], cache["journal"]["_TRANSPORT"])
          - set(attributes["boot_id"], cache["journal"]["_BOOT_ID"])
          - set(attributes["pid"], cache["journal"]["_PID"])
          - set(attributes["host_id"], "${env:HOST_ID}")
          - set(attributes["provider_instance_id"], "${env:INSTANCE_ID}")
          - set(attributes["incarnation"], "${env:INCARNATION_ID}")
          - set(attributes["environment"], "staging")
          - set(attributes["region"], "us-central1")
          - set(attributes["generation"], attributes["journal_unit"]) where IsMatch(attributes["journal_unit"], "^proxy-")
          - set(attributes["log.name"], "superserve_host_logs")
          - set(resource.attributes["cloud.platform"], "gcp_compute_engine")
          - set(resource.attributes["gcp.project_id"], "example-project")
          - set(resource.attributes["host.id"], "${env:INSTANCE_ID}")
          - set(resource.attributes["cloud.availability_zone"], "us-central1-a")
          - set(severity_number, SEVERITY_NUMBER_INFO)
          - set(severity_number, SEVERITY_NUMBER_WARN) where Int(cache["journal"]["PRIORITY"]) == 4
          - set(severity_number, SEVERITY_NUMBER_ERROR) where Int(cache["journal"]["PRIORITY"]) <= 3
          - set(severity_number, SEVERITY_NUMBER_DEBUG) where Int(cache["journal"]["PRIORITY"]) == 7
          - set(attributes["parse_outcome"], "failure") where cache["application"] == true
          - set(attributes["parse_outcome"], "success") where cache["application"] == true and IsMap(cache["parsed"])
          - set(severity_text, ConvertCase(cache["parsed"]["level"], "lower")) where IsString(cache["parsed"]["level"])
          - set(severity_text, ConvertCase(cache["parsed"]["severity"], "lower")) where severity_text == "" and IsString(cache["parsed"]["severity"])
          - set(severity_number, SEVERITY_NUMBER_DEBUG) where severity_text == "debug" or severity_text == "trace"
          - set(severity_number, SEVERITY_NUMBER_INFO) where severity_text == "info"
          - set(severity_number, SEVERITY_NUMBER_WARN) where severity_text == "warn" or severity_text == "warning"
          - set(severity_number, SEVERITY_NUMBER_ERROR) where severity_text == "error"
          - set(severity_number, SEVERITY_NUMBER_FATAL) where severity_text == "fatal" or severity_text == "panic"
          - set(attributes["_private"], cache)
  transform/approved_fields:
    error_mode: silent
    log_statements:
      - context: log
        statements:
          - set(body["message"], attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["message"]) where IsString(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["message"]) and Len(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["message"]) <= 2048 and not IsMatch(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["message"], "(?i)(authorization|bearer |password|secret|token[=:]|-----BEGIN|command[=:])")
          - set(body["msg"], attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["msg"]) where IsString(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["msg"]) and Len(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["msg"]) <= 2048 and not IsMatch(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["msg"], "(?i)(authorization|bearer |password|secret|token[=:]|-----BEGIN|command[=:])")
          - set(body["event"], attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["event"]) where IsString(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["event"]) and Len(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["event"]) <= 2048 and not IsMatch(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["event"], "(?i)(authorization|bearer |password|secret|token[=:]|-----BEGIN|command[=:])")
          - set(body["request_id"], attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["request_id"]) where IsString(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["request_id"]) and Len(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["request_id"]) <= 2048 and not IsMatch(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["request_id"], "(?i)(authorization|bearer |password|secret|token[=:]|-----BEGIN|command[=:])")
          - set(body["sandbox_id"], attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["sandbox_id"]) where IsString(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["sandbox_id"]) and Len(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["sandbox_id"]) <= 2048 and not IsMatch(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["sandbox_id"], "(?i)(authorization|bearer |password|secret|token[=:]|-----BEGIN|command[=:])")
          - set(body["vm_id"], attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["vm_id"]) where IsString(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["vm_id"]) and Len(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["vm_id"]) <= 2048 and not IsMatch(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["vm_id"], "(?i)(authorization|bearer |password|secret|token[=:]|-----BEGIN|command[=:])")
          - set(body["operation"], attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["operation"]) where IsString(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["operation"]) and Len(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["operation"]) <= 2048 and not IsMatch(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["operation"], "(?i)(authorization|bearer |password|secret|token[=:]|-----BEGIN|command[=:])")
          - set(body["component"], attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["component"]) where IsString(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["component"]) and Len(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["component"]) <= 2048 and not IsMatch(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["component"], "(?i)(authorization|bearer |password|secret|token[=:]|-----BEGIN|command[=:])")
          - set(body["error_code"], attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["error_code"]) where IsString(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["error_code"]) and Len(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["error_code"]) <= 2048 and not IsMatch(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["error_code"], "(?i)(authorization|bearer |password|secret|token[=:]|-----BEGIN|command[=:])")
          - set(body["status"], attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["status"]) where IsString(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["status"]) and Len(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["status"]) <= 2048 and not IsMatch(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["status"], "(?i)(authorization|bearer |password|secret|token[=:]|-----BEGIN|command[=:])")
          - set(body["duration_ms"], attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["duration_ms"]) where IsString(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["duration_ms"]) and Len(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["duration_ms"]) <= 2048 and not IsMatch(attributes["_private"]["parsed"]["duration_ms"], "(?i)(authorization|bearer |password|secret|token[=:]|-----BEGIN|command[=:])")
          # Keep useful host diagnostics without copying arbitrary command or tenant text.
          - set(body["diagnostic"], "host service event") where attributes["_private"]["application"] != true
          - set(body["diagnostic"], "out of memory") where attributes["_private"]["application"] != true and IsMatch(attributes["_private"]["journal"]["MESSAGE"], "(?i)(out of memory|oom.kill|memory cgroup out)")
          - set(body["diagnostic"], "no space left on device") where attributes["_private"]["application"] != true and IsMatch(attributes["_private"]["journal"]["MESSAGE"], "(?i)no space left on device")
          - set(body["diagnostic"], "file descriptor exhaustion") where attributes["_private"]["application"] != true and IsMatch(attributes["_private"]["journal"]["MESSAGE"], "(?i)(too many open files|file-max limit)")
          - set(body["diagnostic"], "network or namespace resource exhaustion") where attributes["_private"]["application"] != true and IsMatch(attributes["_private"]["journal"]["MESSAGE"], "(?i)(conntrack.*full|namespace.*(fail|limit)|veth.*fail)")
          - set(body["diagnostic"], "mount resource exhaustion") where attributes["_private"]["application"] != true and IsMatch(attributes["_private"]["journal"]["MESSAGE"], "(?i)mount.*(fail|limit|space)")
          - set(body["diagnostic"], "service failed") where attributes["_private"]["journal"]["_PID"] == "1" and IsMatch(attributes["_private"]["journal"]["MESSAGE"], "(?i)(failed|failure)")
          - set(body["diagnostic"], "service started") where attributes["_private"]["journal"]["_PID"] == "1" and IsMatch(attributes["_private"]["journal"]["MESSAGE"], "^Started ")
          - set(body["diagnostic"], "service stopped") where attributes["_private"]["journal"]["_PID"] == "1" and IsMatch(attributes["_private"]["journal"]["MESSAGE"], "^Stopped ")
          - set(attributes["host_logging_export_error"], "true") where attributes["journal_unit"] == "superserve-otel-logs.service" and IsMatch(attributes["_private"]["journal"]["MESSAGE"], "(?i)(export.*fail|permission denied|drop|storage.*full|queue.*full|cursor.*(fail|invalid))")
          - set(attributes["host_logging_heartbeat"], "true") where attributes["journal_unit"] == "superserve-host-logging-heartbeat.service"
          - delete_key(attributes, "_private")
  filter/info_plus:
    error_mode: propagate
    logs:
      log_record:
        - 'severity_number < SEVERITY_NUMBER_INFO'

exporters:
  otlp_http/cloud:
    endpoint: https://telemetry.googleapis.com
    encoding: json
    compression: gzip
    auth:
      authenticator: googleclientauth
    timeout: 15s
    retry_on_failure:
      enabled: true
      initial_interval: 1s
      max_interval: 30s
      max_elapsed_time: 0s
    sending_queue:
      enabled: true
      storage: file_storage/queue
      sizer: bytes
      queue_size: 536870912
      num_consumers: 2
      batch:
        sizer: bytes
        min_size: 65536
        max_size: 262144
        flush_timeout: 1s

service:
  extensions: [googleclientauth, file_storage/cursor, file_storage/queue]
  pipelines:
    logs:
      receivers: [journald]
      # Batch only after durable acceptance into the exporter queue.
      processors: [memory_limiter, filter/approved_sources, transform/trusted_payload, filter/info_plus, transform/approved_fields]
      exporters: [otlp_http/cloud]
  telemetry:
    logs:
      level: info
      encoding: json
    metrics:
      level: normal
      readers:
        - pull:
            exporter:
              prometheus:
                host: 127.0.0.1
                port: 18888
